captions.detailed: This 3D model features a multi-compartment pill box organizer alongside its matching protective lid. The organizer is configured as a grid of fourteen open rectangular compartments, arranged in a seven-by-two layout. The lid is a shallow, flat tray with side walls designed to slide or snap onto the top of the organizer to keep contents secure.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric pill box organizer in OpenSCAD with a matching lid. The design must allow users to customize the number of days (columns) and compartments per day (rows), individual compartment dimensions, wall thickness, and opt to include embossed text labels for days and times using the write.scad library.
captions.factory: The script uses a custom 'box' module consisting of a difference of two cubes to form each compartment. A nested for-loop iterates through the 'number_days' and 'number_per_day' parameters to construct the grid, while optionally adding text labels on the bottom faces using the write() module. The 'print_lid' module creates a thin-walled enclosure using subtracted cubes, and matching hinge nubs are added using cylinders, spheres, and linear extrusions of 2D polygons.
